privacy.anonymousHeader: What you give us when you use ParkProof without an account
privacy.anonymousIntro: ParkProof works fully anonymously by default. We do not require sign-in, we do not record an account, and the parking sessions you log live in your own browser's localStorage. They never leave your device.
privacy.anonymousThings: Three things do leave your device, even in anonymous mode:
privacy.anonymousAnthropic: Sign photos + GPS coordinates are sent to Anthropic (Claude vision) to translate the sign. We don't store them server-side; Anthropic's retention policy applies.
privacy.anonymousNominatim: GPS coordinates are sent to OpenStreetMap Nominatim to resolve the street address. Nominatim does not require a key and applies their public retention policy.
privacy.anonymousCloudwatch: A random per-result UUID + a "correct / retake" verdict are logged to AWS CloudWatch when you tap the verification card. No PII; aggregate signal for prompt tuning.
privacy.signedInHeader: What you give us when you sign in
privacy.signedInIntro: Signing in is optional. It enables cloud sync — the same sessions visible across all your devices.
privacy.signedInThings: When you sign in, additional data leaves your device:
privacy.signedInEmail: Your email address — stored in AWS Cognito; used as your account identifier and for password reset.
privacy.signedInSessions: Every parking session you save — stored in AWS DynamoDB, keyed to your Cognito user ID. Includes timestamps, GPS, sign rules, the AI's translation, your notes, and the cryptographic signature.
privacy.signedInPhotos: Every photo attached to a session — stored in AWS S3 under a path that includes your user ID, accessible only to you while signed in.
privacy.locationCopy: All cloud storage is in AWS Sydney (ap-southeast-2). Data does not leave Australia for storage purposes. Anthropic and Nominatim may process data internationally during a single API call; those calls do not persist.
privacy.dontSell: We don't sell your data, ever.
privacy.dontShare: We don't share it with third parties beyond the AWS, Anthropic and Nominatim flows above.
privacy.dontAds: We don't use it for advertising. ParkProof has no ads.
privacy.dontTrack: We don't track you across other sites.
privacy.dontFingerprint: We don't run analytics that fingerprint your device.
privacy.rightsExport: Export. Tap "Download as PDF" in Account to get a complete document with every session you've stored — cover page summary plus a per-session detail block with photos.
privacy.rightsDelete: Delete. Tap "Delete account" in Account. Removes your sign-in record, every DynamoDB row, and every S3 photo within seconds. Irreversible.
privacy.rightsCorrect: Correct. You edit your sessions in-app — every change syncs to the cloud immediately if signed in.
privacy.rightsAnonymous: If you don't sign in, all your data is on your device — clear your browser storage to delete it.
privacy.photosCopy: Photos are resized to ≤1200px and re-encoded as JPEG at 0.82 quality on your device before they leave the browser. The original high-resolution camera capture never leaves your phone.
privacy.signingCopy: When you sign in (or stay anonymous — both work), each session is signed by an AWS KMS-managed ECDSA P-256 key. The private key never leaves AWS. The public key is published at /parkproof-public-key.pem for anyone (a council, court, insurer) to verify the evidence chain using openssl dgst — see the appendix in any exported PDF for the step-by-step.
privacy.contactCopy: For questions or to exercise your rights outside of the in-app controls, email melroy@dsouza.tech.
privacy.complaintCopy: Unhappy with our response? You can complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC).

evidence.title: ParkProof — Parking Evidence
evidence.ambientPhotoCaption: Captured by the driver at the time of parking to demonstrate no signs were visible.
evidence.noAmbientCaptured: No surroundings photo was captured for this session.
evidence.noSignRules: No posted restrictions captured. This session was logged at a spot the driver asserted had no signs.
evidence.gpsNoticeBody: The GPS reading at capture time was {{accuracy}} — wider than typical for evidence purposes. The coordinates above identify a point within that radius, not an exact spot. Common causes: indoor / multi-storey carparks, Starlink or VPN connections, or weak satellite signal. Reviewers should weight the captured address against this radius.
evidence.statement: This record was generated automatically by ParkProof at the time of parking. The arrival timestamp, GPS coordinates, sign translation, and photographs constitute a contemporaneous evidence record suitable for attachment to a parking infringement review submission with the relevant Australian local council.
evidence.guidanceFreeNoExpiry: Free to park. No expiry shown on the sign.

signature.title: Cryptographic signature
signature.intro: This evidence record was signed by ParkProof's AWS KMS-managed private key at the time of saving. The signature lets any third party (council, court, insurer) verify that the metadata and photo hashes below have not been altered since the signed_at timestamp. The private key never leaves AWS; the public key is published openly for verification.
signature.canonicalPayloadHeader: Canonical payload (the exact bytes that were signed):
signature.verifyStep1: 1. Save the canonical payload above to a file: payload.txt (no trailing newline)
signature.verifyStep2: 2. Save the signature base64 string above to a file: sig.base64

fullExport.title: ParkProof — Account Export
fullExport.intro: This document is a complete, contemporaneous record of every parking session this account has logged with ParkProof. Each session was captured at the moment of parking with GPS, photographs, and an AI-translated reading of the parking sign. Where a session was signed with the ParkProof KMS key, the badge on that section indicates a verifiable cryptographic signature exists (export the individual session PDF for the full signature appendix).
fullExport.emptyState: No parking sessions have been saved to this account yet.
